measurements.name: ev_a
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_a WHEN v(pvc)=v(pvh) RISE=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_a2
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_a2 WHEN v(pvc)=v(pvh) RISE=2 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_a3
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_a3 WHEN v(pvc)=v(pvh) RISE=3 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_b
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_b WHEN v(pcmph)=1.6500 RISE=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_c
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_c WHEN v(clk)=1.6500 RISE=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_d
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_d WHEN v(pvc)=v(pvl) FALL=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_e
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_e WHEN v(pcmpl)=1.6500 RISE=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: ev_f
measurements.spice: .meas tran ev_f WHEN v(clk)=1.6500 FALL=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: v0
measurements.spice: .meas tran v0 FIND v(pvc) WHEN v(clk)=1.6500 FALL=1 TD=700n

measurements.name: vh
measurements.spice: .meas tran vh AVG v(pvh) FROM=900n TO=1200n

measurements.name: vl
measurements.spice: .meas tran vl AVG v(pvl) FROM=900n TO=1200n

measurements.name: vib
measurements.spice: .meas tran vib AVG v(pibias) FROM=900n TO=1200n

measurements.name: vpb
measurements.spice: .meas tran vpb AVG v(ppb) FROM=900n TO=1200n

measurements.name: vcpk
measurements.spice: .meas tran vcpk MAX v(pvc) FROM=700n TO=1200n
